message: 守護天使は気難し屋？

name: Melilot
message: 「That's all for today's practice. Good work, everyone.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ugh, it stinks today too! Please change it to a nicer smell! Like oranges or something.」

name: Ria
message: 「I know how you feel, but that wouldn't make for good practice.」
Ria-senpai, Misa, and I managed to avoid falling victim to the stench.
I hope it was due to skill rather than luck, though.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you. Forgive me for leaving you all lonely, Rii-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, are you coming along today too, Akane-chan?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's no telling what this one might do if I take my eyes off her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What am I, a violent criminal under escort?!」

name: Ria
message: 「I know! Maybe I'll have dinner at Yuugiri-an today too. I can just let my big sister know.」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister, I'm going too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then count me in too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Do you even have the money?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll pay it back with labor later.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're trying to leave me out, aren't you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, please stay behind for a moment. It won't take long.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I'll catch up with you guys later.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Got it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Go get chewed out thoroughly. You're so unreliable.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hehehe. By the time the president gets back, there won't be a single thing left, so be prepared.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's wrong?」
Nanaka whispered in my ear.

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you're talking about leaving me out, I won't have it. Speak up against it, okay?」
Her warm breath tickled my ear.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can fight just fine too, you know!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Can you borrow the power of your Guardian Angel right here, right now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes.」
I gripped the Rosary tightly with all my strength.
Then, in response to it, my body grew hot!
My mouth began moving on its own.

name: Synn
message: 「Guiding the master, descending by the ancient covenant--Avanshell, Angel of Pitch-Black Darkness!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now, just like that, please manifest your Demon Lord power.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please manifest it and show me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Trans-form! Hyah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, just as I thought.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please try it one more time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Okay.」

name: Synn
message: 「Trans-form! Hyah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I reverted back.」

name: Paqy
message: 「No.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, what's going on?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see... So the Guardian Angel's power rejects the Demon Lord's power?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it because one's a Demon Lord and the other's an Angel?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Once a Guardian Angel acknowledges someone, they are supposed to lend their power unless they judge it to be an abuse of power, however.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Avanshell was especially stubborn, so you'd think she'd lend her power even if Synn-sama didn't want it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is this happening...」

name: Melilot
message: 「With the Demon Lord power you can currently exert, Sakura-kun--even though you've grown stronger since we last fought--you still don't measure up to Soltia, let alone Bylous.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I had thought we could improve the situation if we were able to add the Guardian Angel's power to the mix, however.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't get so down on yourself. Your true power's gotta be way more than this, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy, I don't need empty comfort.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Have a little faith in me, man. That hurts.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed, mathematically speaking, it is just as Great Sage Paqy says.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Based on calculations using the magical energy data of past Demon Lords, the results indicate your latent power slightly surpasses Bylous's.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way.」
That overwhelming power I felt back then.
I can't even imagine wielding a force even greater than that.

name: Melilot
message: 「However, power that cannot be exerted is no different from not existing at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're... right.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Something is obstructing the full activation of your power.」

name: Synn
message: 「Something? Like what?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You already got a hunch anyway, don'tcha?」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it that I'm lacking?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'd say it's either spirit, guts, or self-awareness.」

name: Synn
message: 「But! Becoming aware that I'm the Demon Lord is supposed to be the whole reason I became able to use this power in the first place!」

name: Synn
message: 「I already have self-awareness, so... is it spirit or guts?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, from watching your training, when it comes to spirit and guts, I'd say you rank pretty high even among past Demon Lords.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then--」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is self-awareness, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way... What am I supposed to do!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「When it comes to this, it's an issue with your heart, Sakura-kun, so there's nothing I can do about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um. Earlier, you said that once a guardian angel acknowledges someone, they're supposed to lend their power as long as they don't judge it to be an abuse of power, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you referring to Yuugiri-san?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. If that's the case, what happened to Nanaka shouldn't have occurred.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Judging from past cases, the cause does not lie with the guardian angel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, with Nanaka?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. That's why I suspected Soltia had cast some sort of magical curse on Yuugiri-san, however...」

name: Synn
message: 「During the home visit?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you examine Nanaka?」

name: Melilot
message: 「After a fashion. Unfortunately, however, she wasn't very cooperative, so I couldn't perform a thorough examination and may have overlooked something.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Melilot
message: 「She seems convinced that I'm trying to remove her from the Crusaders. She stubbornly insisted that she can fight and that there's nothing wrong.」
'If this is about kicking me out, I won't have it. Speak up against it, okay?'
'I can fight properly too, you know!'

name: Melilot
message: 「Curses that act upon the mind often produce no physical changes, making them difficult to detect without the subject's cooperation.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Part of the reason I stopped you today, Sakura-kun, was that I wanted to ask you about Yuugiri-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you going to remove Nanaka from the Crusaders?」

name: Melilot
message: 「In terms of fighting strength, that's impossible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean you'd want to remove her if you had enough fighting strength to spare?」

name: Melilot
message: 「We don't have the luxury of discussing hypotheticals.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Around when did Yuugiri-san become unable to borrow her guardian angel's power completely?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There must have been signs even before she fought Arden.」

name: Synn
message: 「The last time we fought Pasta... I feel like she was strangely weak.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Since she was able to borrow that power normally up until then, something must have happened before that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lack of sleep... no, that's not it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Lack of sleep?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, wait, no. That was after the thing with Pasta, anyway.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is a possibility that it is the effect of a curse.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it's just simple lack of sleep.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...A guardian angel would never withhold their power simply because you are in poor physical condition.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then lack of sleep has nothing to do with it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...If it is due to your physical condition, it has nothing to do with it.」
So if it's mental, it might have something to do with it, huh.

name: Synn
message: 「That assignment. Did you investigate it, Melilot?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Thoroughly. However, there was nothing wrong with that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so...」
Besides, the home visit was after fighting Pasta, anyway...

name: Melilot
message: 「Did anything happen in November?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you remember anything that bothers you, no matter how small, please tell me. I'm counting on you.」
